title: The Reign and Fall of King Ahaz
description: King Ahaz of Judah does evil in the Lord's sight, makes idols for the Baals and burns his sons in the valley of Hinnom. As punishment, Judah suffers defeat against the Arameans and Israel, and Pekah kills 120,000 men. The prophet Oded and the leaders of Ephraim persuade the Israelites to send the captives back. Edomites and Philistines also attack Judah. Ahaz seeks help from Tiglath-Pileser of Assyria and sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, but this only leads him deeper into unfaithfulness. He shuts the doors of the Lord's house and dies, and his son Hezekiah becomes king.
